readOnly: No helper account actions are available.
updated: Helper status updated. Your reason was recorded in the audit log.

dialog.suspendDescription: Their open offers are withdrawn and they're hidden from search.
dialog.reinstateDescription: Their helper suspension will be lifted. Your reason will be recorded in the audit log.
dialog.hint: Use 10–1,000 characters. This reason is kept in the audit log.
dialog.required: Enter a reason with at least 10 characters.
dialog.tooLong: Keep the reason to 1,000 characters or fewer.
dialog.notAllowed: You can't change this helper's status now. Refresh the page to check the available actions.

bookingsCaption: This person's bookings as client and helper, newest first
rewardsHint: View reward details here. Open the reward queue to make a decision.

strikeDialog.title: Reverse this strike
strikeDialog.description: {strike}. The strike stays on record and stops counting against the helper. Your reason goes to the audit log.
strikeDialog.hint: Explain the outcome of the appeal in 10 to 1,000 characters.
strikeDialog.required: Give a reason of at least 10 characters.
strikeDialog.notAllowed: This strike can't be reversed. Refresh to see its current state.

deliveriesHint: The latest messages for this person's notifications. Failed sends are tried 3 more times.

deliveryReasons.email_suppressed: Their email bounced or was marked as spam
deliveryReasons.already_read: They read the conversation before it went out
deliveryReasons.blocked: One of them blocked the other before it went out
deliveryReasons.texts_off: Texts are off on this site (no text provider is set up)

deliveryTypes.city_live_client: City live: post a first task

previews.previewReason: Review the linked account activity before restoring this helper.

badgesHint: Earned from completed, paid bookings. Revoke one earned unfairly: it's hidden everywhere until restored.

badgeDialog.revokeDescription: {badge} disappears from the profile, cards and account page, and isn't counted again until someone restores it.
badgeDialog.restoreDescription: {badge} shows again, counted from the person's bookings now.
badgeDialog.hint: Kept in the audit log. At least 10 characters.
badgeDialog.required: Write why, in at least 10 characters.
badgeDialog.notAllowed: You can't change this badge. It may have changed already: refresh the page.

reasonAction.hint: Kept in the audit log. At least 10 characters.
reasonAction.required: Write why, in at least 10 characters.
reasonAction.failed: That didn't go through. Try again.

account.title: Account
account.hint: Suspending or banning stops sign-in, ends every session they have now, and suspends their helper profile. A ban takes two people: one asks, another approves.
account.staffNote: This is a staff account. Remove their staff roles first.
account.notAllowed: You can't do that on this account now. It may have changed: refresh the page.

suspend.title: Suspend this account
suspend.description: They're signed out everywhere, can't sign in, and their helper profile is suspended. You can reinstate them later.

reinstate.title: Reinstate this account
reinstate.description: They can sign in again. A suspended helper profile stays suspended until you reinstate it in the helper section.

request_ban.title: Request a ban
request_ban.description: A ban needs a second reviewer: another trust and safety member or an admin approves it before it takes effect.

approve_ban.title: Approve this ban
approve_ban.description: They're signed out everywhere and can't sign in again. Only an admin can lift a ban.

decline_ban.title: Decline this ban request
decline_ban.description: The account stays as it is. The request and your reason stay in the audit log.

clear_contact_hold.title: Clear the hold on sign-in details
clear_contact_hold.description: They can change their email and phone and add ways to sign in again. Clear it only once the account is back with its owner.

account.contactHold: Email, phone and sign-in changes held since {date}: someone used the “Not you?” link in a contact change notice. Check its case before clearing the hold.
